column1: # The books of amadeos-sample-books: public-domain classics, three per desktop language.
# Columns (tab-separated): language, file name, author, title, source, id or URL.
#   source "standardebooks": a Standard Ebooks URL (their editions are CC0)
#   source "gutenberg": a Project Gutenberg ebook number; "auto" makes fetch-books.py look it up by
#   author, title and language and write the number it found back into this file
# Every author died before 1955, so the texts are in the public domain in the EU and the USA.
